title: The best band in California that nobody would hire
summary: His California band had Abe Lincoln, Bob McCracken, Smokey Stover, bassist Stillman and Don Owens, rehearsing in his living room.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Yeah - Bob McCracken and I had a sensational drummer, who is dead now - Smokey Stover--
And, he also played fluegal- horn. I had a wonderful bass player called Stillman

and he played trumpet as well as the bass-- and, uh, I had Don Owens on the piano; I said Abe Lincoln, and myself-- it was a hell of a band. We used to rehearse in my living room and I want to tell you, it was fantastic. We couldn't give it away; you couldn't give it away.
